title: tidb-rs tracker
description: TiDB tests, the Go code they exercise, and tidb-rs progress. Built from data/*.tsv.

tests.description: Go unit tests and integration test files of TiDB at data/source.tsv tidb_commit.

features.description: v0 features: one per Go source file; symbols = functions in it reached by some test.

go_funcs.description: Every function and method declared in the non-test .go files under pkg/ at tidb_commit, reached by a test or not. symbol uses the naming of features.symbols (Func / Recv.Method); join go_funcs.file = features.feature. lines = end_line - start_line + 1 (func keyword to closing brace). generated = 1 for generated files (Code generated ... DO NOT EDIT., pkg/parser/parser.go).

go_decls.description: Package-level types, vars and consts declared in the non-test .go files under pkg/ at tidb_commit (cmd/refgraph -decls). A spec in a parenthesized group spans its own lines; an ungrouped one starts at the keyword.

go_file_refs.description: File -> file references under pkg/ (cmd/refgraph): number of distinct (function in from_file, target in to_file) references by kind: funcs (functions, concrete methods), ifaces (interface methods), types, vars_consts. Self edges excluded. Function-level edges: work/go_refs.tsv (scripts/refgraph.sh), not committed.

test_feature.description: Which features a test exercises. weight = the feature's share of the test's specificity mass; links below 0.01 are omitted.

cov_status.description: Outcome of each test's coverage run (the failpoint re-run's, if any). ok = mapping complete; failed = run stopped early, mapping incomplete; skipped = t.Skip or not compiled in. detail = reason.

scope.description: Packages in scope for a tidb-rs phase (P1 = prototype).

rs_run.description: R1: the integration-test run imported into rs_* (tidb-rs commit, Go TiDB version, test files' TiDB commit, date, runner, duration).

rs_integration.description: R1: per integration test file, statement outcomes when run in hybrid mode (all statements on Go TiDB, reads also on tidb-rs, compared live). statements = match + mismatch + unsupported + b_error + a_error + skipped + write; score = match / (match + mismatch + unsupported + b_error).

rs_integration_reason.description: R1: outcome counts by statement class and reason: tidb-rs's unsupported message, its error, the mismatch kind, Go TiDB's own error (a_error) or why a read was skipped. Names and numbers are replaced by ? and N.

rs_integration_mismatch.description: R1: every read where tidb-rs answered differently from Go TiDB. kind: rows, order, columns, metadata, error, shape, warnings.

tests_for_feature.title: Tests that exercise a feature
tests_for_feature.sql: SELECT tf.pkg, tf.test, tf.weight, t.path, t.line, t.uses_store FROM test_feature tf JOIN tests t ON t.kind = 'unit' AND t.pkg = tf.pkg AND t.name = tf.test WHERE tf.feature = :feature ORDER BY tf.weight DESC

features_of_test.title: Features a test exercises
features_of_test.sql: SELECT tf.feature, tf.weight, f.funcs FROM test_feature tf JOIN features f ON f.feature = tf.feature WHERE tf.pkg = :pkg AND tf.test = :test ORDER BY tf.weight DESC

incomplete_mappings.title: Tests whose mapping is incomplete or missing (failed or skipped), with the reason
incomplete_mappings.sql: SELECT c.status, c.pkg, c.test, c.detail, t.uses_fp FROM cov_status c JOIN tests t ON t.kind = 'unit' AND t.pkg = c.pkg AND t.name = c.test WHERE c.status IN ('failed', 'skipped') ORDER BY c.status, c.pkg, c.test

rs_files_by_share.title: Integration files by share of scored reads that match (R1)
rs_files_by_share.sql: SELECT file, reads, match + mismatch + unsupported + b_error AS scored, match, round(100.0 * match / NULLIF(match + mismatch + unsupported + b_error, 0), 1) AS share, mismatch, unsupported, b_error, a_error, skipped FROM rs_integration ORDER BY share DESC, scored DESC

rs_mismatches.title: Reads where tidb-rs answered differently (R1)
rs_mismatches.sql: SELECT file, line, conn, kind, detail, sql FROM rs_integration_mismatch ORDER BY kind, file, line

rs_unsupported_reasons.title: Why tidb-rs answered 'not supported' (R1)
rs_unsupported_reasons.sql: SELECT reason, sum(statements) AS statements, sum(files) AS file_hits FROM rs_integration_reason WHERE outcome = 'unsupported' GROUP BY reason ORDER BY statements DESC
